_comment: Reference for setting DEV / QA / PROD base URLs in API Test Suite v2.2 node fields.

DEV.note: Local dev server — replace with your actual dev URL

QA.note: Public test server used in this demo

PROD.note: Replace with your real production base URL

how_to_switch.step_1: Set 'Active Environment' field in API Test Suite v2.2 to DEV, QA, or PROD
how_to_switch.step_2: Set the matching Base URL field (DEV Base URL / QA Base URL / PROD Base URL)
how_to_switch.step_3: Run — the base URL is automatically substituted across all request URLs

parallel_vs_sequential.sequential_workers_1: Preserves variable chaining — token flows into downstream requests
parallel_vs_sequential.parallel_workers_3+: All requests fire simultaneously — no variable chaining, good for smoke tests
